transcript: This morning, theater fans gathered in Times Square for the Broadway Picnic Basket Auction, where all of your favorite Broadway and off-Broadway shows put together picnic baskets to auction off for Broadway Cares. The event was sponsored by Playbill and the Broadway musical schmigadoon, As a nod to the picnic basket auction that takes place in the show, it was even hosted by Brad Oscar, who plays Mayor Menlove in the show, and all in all raised over $30,000 for charity. The most expensive basket was the Lost Boys basket, which went for over $5,000. It included a lot of signed props and merch, including a custom Lost Boys jacket signed by the full cast. I think the coolest thing up for auction was probably the Schmigadoon basket, which included two tickets to see SNL Which is crazy. That one went for $2600. September L. Davis was also there with a basket from her new musical proof. It was really great to see her in good spirits after her near death experience where she died for six seconds. I was really close to bidding on this Hamilton basket, which included a shirt that you can only get if you join the Broadway company, along with clippings from some of the costumes in the show and the infamous Hamilton Yankees baseball cap. That one went for just over $1,000, which I actually think is a steal. But all in all it was a really fun Event and raised some money for a great cause. And I kind of hope this becomes a yearly tradition.
classificationReason: Covers a charity event featuring multiple shows (Schmigadoon, Lost Boys, Proof, Hamilton, etc.) with no single production as the focus. No first-hand review of any individual show.
